title: Portugal: A Yoga & Coastal Retreat

teachers.name: Dawn Thie
bio: Find Your True Self. It is Dawn’s highest intention to help guide students to a deeper relationship with Self. By moving our bodies and our energy, we free our soul to be seen and we can connect to parts of Self that are waiting to be explored.

Dawn carefully designs classes to clear the energetic channels within the body to create more space and open the path to inner peace. Incorporating the 8 Limb Path of Yoga, she invites students to explore something deeper within themselves using asana, breath work, intention and focus, in a way that meets students where they are. Feeling into the energy present in the room, Dawn uses her authentic voice offering clear and concise guidance, while weaving in yoga philosophy and heartfelt intention for both a physical and spiritual experience. All through a trauma informed approach.

When we connect to Self, we begin to experience the innate peace within and thus walk along this planet more peacefully. Dawn has been leading retreats nationally and internationally, as well as teacher trainings and workshops around the country. Originally trained in the traditional Sivananda Hatha style of yoga, Dawn’s classes offer a classical approach to yoga with a modern twist of accessibility. To learn more about Dawn please check our her website, I AM Dawn Thie Yoga.

intro: A yoga retreat through Portugal’s captivating contrasts—beginning in Lisbon and unfolding along the wild, sunlit coastline of the Costa Vicentina.
about_body: Lisbon sets the tone—textured, luminous, and quietly alive with culture. Your first days unfold inside the rhythm of the city, where mornings begin with yoga and strong coffee, and afternoons slip easily into neighborhoods rich with history, design, and local life. It’s an immersion that feels both expansive and intimate.

Then, a shift. South, toward the coast—where the landscape opens and the pace softens without effort. Cliffs meet the Atlantic. Light lingers longer. Days are shaped by salt air, coastal walks, unhurried meals, and time that feels distinctly your own.
The transition is intentional. From city energy to open space. From stimulation to stillness. From outward experience to inward connection.
A retreat designed not just to take you somewhere beautiful—but to move you, gradually and completely, into a different way of being.

accommodations.label: 3 nights in Lisbon: a boutique stay in São Bento
text: Tucked into Lisbon’s São Bento neighborhood, our boutique stay feels both intimate and quietly distinctive. Each space is thoughtfully designed, blending contemporary lines with artistic details that reflect the creative energy of the area.
There’s a sense of ease to it—comfortable, understated, and personal—where mornings begin with a beautifully prepared breakfast and the city moves just outside your door, yet never overwhelming.
It’s the kind of place that lets you settle in quickly and experience Lisbon in a more local, authentic and unhurried way.

accommodations.label: 4 nights in Costa Vicentina: a secluded boutique stay
text: The second half of our experience unfolds in a quietly extraordinary retreat set within a protected valley on Portugal’s wild southwest coast. Surrounded by rolling hills, eucalyptus groves, and open fields that stretch toward the sea, the property feels both grounded and expansive—deeply connected to the land it rests on.

Days move slowly here. Morning light over the valley, long walks through nature just beyond your door, time by the pool, and meals rooted in the rhythms of the region. There is space to explore, to rest, to soften.
The atmosphere is intimate and unforced—beautiful without excess, thoughtful in every detail. It’s the kind of place people return to.

faqs.question: Do you accept bitcoin?
answer: In addition to credit card payments we also accept wire transfers, Zelle and Bitcoin. Please inquire for more details.

faqs.question: What is the cancellation policy?
answer: All payments are 100% non refundable and non-transferable. We recommend that you buy trip cancellation insurance immediately upon making your initial deposit to cover any travel hiccups or complications that may arise between now and the time of your retreat. No exceptions are possible so please cover your trip by connecting with an insurance company that offers the right policy for you.

faqs.question: What happens if my travel plans change?
answer: There are no refunds as per our cancellation policies. We highly recommend that all of our guests secure a quality travel insurance that will cover them for any event which may cause a change of travel plans, including personal health issues or personal situations in general which may affect travel plans.

faqs.question: Are flight delays or cancellations covered?
answer: Not by us: transportation delays, cancellations or changes due to strikes, labor disputes, or lockouts from airlines, boats, ferries or any type of transportation are among the events we recommend covering with travel insurance.

faqs.question: Where can I find the full terms & conditions?
answer: The full terms and conditions are published at https://yogaadventuresworldwide.com/termsandconditions/ . By submitting payments toward your retreat you accept them.

booking.balance_note: The balance of your retreat (minus your $1,000usd initial deposit) is due 90 days prior to arrival. All details with instructions for settling up will be emailed to you three months prior to the retreat.
